name: Nanimo Sonna... Ore wa Karui Kimochi de... ...Ame ga Warui... ...Iya Oppai ga Warui!!
original_name: なにもそんな・・・。俺は軽い気持ちで・・・。・・・雨が悪い・・・。・・・いやオッパイが悪い!!
source:
This beautiful mother used to be a young idol, but now she's happily married, with a cute daughter
One day, she's exploring around town after just moving into a new place,
when she gets a bit lost, and rain starts to fall.
She enters a nearby massage parlor to seek shelter,
and it seems they have a free trial campaign going on.
She figures there can't be any harm in a free massage while she's here.

However, the massage turns into a mother's milk spraying fest...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE289642.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这位美丽的母亲年轻时曾是偶像，如今婚姻幸福，还有个可爱的女儿。
一天，刚搬到新住处的她在镇上闲逛，
不料有些迷路，天又下起了雨。
她走进附近的按摩店避雨，
恰好店里似乎在举办免费体验活动。
既然来了，顺便享受一次免费的按摩，应该也没什么不好。

然而，按摩最后却变成了一场乳汁四溅的狂欢……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE289642.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
